dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I will be stationed at Tatarasuna starting tomorrow. It will be a difficult parting for me."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I hope that my sister will manage the family business well, but the economy hasn't been doing well lately. It won't be easy for her."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I wish that the war would be over soon so that I can come home to share the family responsibilities."

dialogues.speaker: Owner's Reply
dialogues.text: Lad, don't worry! I am sure that you will complete your responsibilities successfully, and that you will return home soon!
